issue.title: Scan the cut at D 61, M 40 with circles at the M 40 zeros

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** Scan the cut at D 61.03, M 40 (kf 21, 25 or 27, beside #231's kf 23) with circles at the M 40 zeros, and the λ_phys control. Recommended by macm3 in #231's summary (its task 2). Low priority.

**Why.** At M 48 the D 61 row moves with the cut (#230). Whether M 40's zeros move with the cut in the same way adds to the evidence that the extras belong to the truncation.

**Acceptance (can fail).** The λ_phys circle winds +1 at each cut, and each M 40 zero's circle winding and position are tabulated against kf.

**Depends on.** #231.

comments.body: **Started** (macm3, 21:01 UTC), on the free thread beside #249 (the coordinator's message; I added the `macm3` and `running` labels, the issue had none; status In Progress). Main 6dd0e718, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, `modecount_cx` with B = 5), nice 10, caffeinate -is, raw folder `I262-macm3/`, README with the reading rule written first. Pattern of #231 (state `up23_D61.0264`, `--M=40`, `--fmax=1e-15`, tags `D61.0264_M40_kf<K>`, n0 20): **kf 21 and kf 25** run now, each a fresh setup (resample the M 32 seed to M 40, Newton, Levenberg-Marquardt; the gate is 1e-15 and a miss stops that cut) followed by five circles: the zero at 2.0426 + 1.1507 i (confirmed by a circle in #231), the B1c zeros 2.7626 + 0.6308 i and 2.9141 + 1.5885 i and the U0 zero 0.0319 + 3.0855 i (moment positions of #231, spreads below 2.3e-2), and the λ_phys control. **kf 23** is the reference from #231 (its M 40 state and cache); the circles at the three zeros that #231 only located by moments are run on it so that the table has one column per cut and the moments are checked. The B1b and strip-U moment zeros (spreads 0.1 to 0.7) are not used. Expected 2 to 3 h (a setup about 10 min, then 5 circles at about 40 s per determinant under load).

## Summary (macm3, 23:18 UTC)

Sorry that the issue had no post since the start. **Result.** At D 61.03, M 40 the zeros of #231 do not stay when the cut changes: of the four M 40 zeros circled, three exist at kf 23 only (absent at kf 21 and at kf 25) and one exists at kf 23 and kf 25 and moves by 0.20. The λ_phys circle winds +1 at all three cuts.

| M 40 zero (#231, kf 23) | kf 21 | kf 23 | kf 25 |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) 2.0426 + 1.1507 i | **0** | +1, 2.0426 + 1.1507 i (#231) | **0** |
| (b) 2.7626 + 0.6308 i (moment) | **0** | +1, **2.7995 + 0.6290 i** (9.7e-7) | **0** |
| (c) 2.9141 + 1.5885 i (moment) | **0** | +1, **2.8997 + 1.5920 i** (3.6e-6) | +1, **3.0615 + 1.7080 i** (9.9e-3) |
| (d) U0 0.0319 + 3.0855 i (moment) | **0** | +1, **0.0715 + 3.0933 i** (1.1e-3) | **0** |
| λ_phys control 2.043533 | +1, 2.043533 (2.6e-8) | +1 (#231, 2.1e-7) | +1, 2.043532 (8.5e-7) |

The kf 23 circles at (b), (c), (d) also check #231's moment positions: they are 0.037, 0.016 and 0.040 from the circle zeros (the moments' spreads were 7.5e-3, 6.8e-3 and 2.3e-2), so the moment spreads are optimistic by a factor of 2 to 5 here. All circles have 0 verification mismatches; (c) at kf 25 needed 40 points and 11 alias bisections.

**Setups.** kf 21 and kf 25: |F| 1.3e-06 in the layout, 1.3e-06 after Newton, **3.8e-19** after Levenberg-Marquardt, gate 1e-15 passed (no state re-converge issue). **Run.** `hp/modecount_circle.py` on `up23_D61.0264`, `--M=40 --kf=<K> --n0=20 --fmax=1e-15`, tags `D61.0264_M40_kf<K>`, circles of R 0.2 (0.3 at U0), 1 thread each, nice 10, caffeinate -is, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, `modecount_cx` with B = 5), main 6dd0e718. kf 21: 5087 s, kf 25: 6143 s, kf 23 reference (3 circles on #231's state and cache): 2981 s; all **awake = wall**. Processes 1 core at 99.5% CPU and 90 to 140 MB each, load 6 to 7 (beside #249's counts). The M 40 states are in the raw folder, `hp/data` is clean for this task.

**Reading, and what it does not show.** A mode would stay at the same λ when the cut changes; these zeros appear at one cut and are absent at the neighbours on both sides, as the D 45 M 48 zero was at kf 21 only (#190). That supports the truncation reading of #231 for M 40 as well. Caveats: a circle of R 0.2 to 0.3 covers a disc, so "absent" means no zero within it, and a zero that moved farther would show as absent (as (c) moves by 0.20 between kf 23 and 25, a displacement near the circle radius); one D (61.03) and three cuts; (a), (b), (d) were not looked for elsewhere at kf 21 and 25.

**Acceptance.** The λ_phys circle winds +1 at each cut: met. Each M 40 zero's winding and position tabulated against kf: above (zero (a) at kf 23 is #231's circle).

**Discrepancies.** None. **Raw.** `I262-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit 67ffdfa (the three circle logs, positions.py and .txt, the copied cache, exits.txt, awake.py and .log, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

None beyond #231's.
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (D 61 M 40: three of four zeros exist at kf 23 only, one moves by 0.20 between kf 23 and 25; lambda_phys +1 at all cuts; raw I262-macm3).
